    Morphisms between interval representations #

    Morphisms between the intervals Y and P i are read off at the point *: their value there is a scalar, multiplicative under composition, and it vanishes on Y ⟶ P i and on P j ⟶ P i for j < i (table (2.2)). A morphism A j ⟶ A i is a scalar multiple of the canonical map a_{ji}.
